title: distribution: prebuilt binaries, homebrew tap, unified installer, .zerostack layout doc
description: Ship story for 1..3 engines + shared substrate. Facts: engines are statically linked single binaries; zerostack crates are compile-time git deps baked in at build — users never install zerostack; only builds fetch it (cargo via SHA pin). Deliverables: (1) GitHub Releases per engine (macos-arm64/x86_64, linux-x86_64/arm64, windows-x86_64) via CI matrix. (2) homebrew tap AdityaVG13/homebrew-zerostack (already referenced in GZ README): formulas tokenzero/fszero/graphzero + meta formula zerostack installing all three. (3) installer script hosted in THIS repo: curl | sh with --all or per-engine flags (winget/scoop manifests later). (4) docs/store-layout.md: canonical .zerostack/ on-disk contract — per-repo store, engine namespaces (fszero/repos/<sid>, graphzero/projects/<key>, tokenzero), shared CAS blobs unified by pinned layout version; installing engines in any order adds namespaces beside existing ones, no migration; version skew across engines guarded by capability negotiation (worst case read_only/disabled, never corruption). (5) later: publish zero-* to crates.io so cargo install tokenzero works without git — blocked on stable semver; keep SHA pins until then.

comments.author: AdityaVG13
comments.text: DECISION (user): start with three separate binaries (tokenzero, fszero, graphzero) as three commands — matches the use-one-alone model and is simplest. Busybox-style single zero multiplexer binary deferred; revisit only if there is real demand.

title: wave 2: zero-codemode — shared rquickjs runtime, containment, plan/step machinery
description: Largest remaining pool: TZ mcp/codemode/* (~8K: exec 3803, journal 969, containment 803, store 702, parser 462), FZ codemode/* (~2.5K: js 732, host 603, connector 466), GZ codemode/* (~3.5K: quickjs 638, steps 574, executor 517, response 512, host_permit 495). Shared crate owns: rquickjs engine setup (unify TZ 0.10 -> 0.12 to match FZ), sandbox/containment policy, plan parsing, step journaling, host-permit model, response envelopes. Engines register only their own host functions/connectors (zero.token.*, zero.fs.*, zero.graph.*). Bisectable: rquickjs bump lands as its own commit inside the wave.

title: wave 1.5: CAS publish/GC core + .zerostack store-root resolution into zero-store
description: Two drift-forbidden pieces move into zero-store. (A) CAS internals: TZ shared_cas.rs (1,485 LOC incl. zerostack.cas-gc.v1 GC), FZ core/cas.rs (341), GZ store CAS — shared publish protocol (temp+fsync+rename), object verify, and the GC state machine live once; fixes the omega-math CRITICAL TOCTOU (GC unlinking concurrently republished objects; publish never takes the GC lock) exactly once instead of three times. (B) Store-root resolution: TZ engine/workspace.rs (~250), FZ core/zerostack_store.rs (137), GZ store/zerostack_store.rs (533) all reimplement .zerostack/ detection, ZEROSTACK_STORE_ROOT/ZERO_STACK_STORE_ROOT precedence, shared-store opt-in, and sha256 project-key namespacing — if these drift, engines put data in different places and interop silently breaks. Shared module owns layout + resolution; engines keep alias envs (TOKENZERO_SHARED_STORE etc.) as thin wrappers. TZ = PR, GZ/FZ direct. Equality gates: digest byte-identical per engine + store-path golden tests (same inputs resolve same paths before/after).

title: wave 4: capability negotiation + cross-engine telemetry schema into shared crates
description: (A) Capability peer validation: FZ core/capability.rs DescriptorFields tolerant extractor, GZ zeroref_capability.rs validate_peer_descriptor, TZ mcp/capability_descriptor.rs — each engine parses the OTHER engines descriptors with alias tolerance (hash.algo vs hash.algorithm, layout_version key drift). This code exists only to reconcile drift; sharing the descriptor schema + validator removes the reason it exists. Engines keep engine-owned fields (remediation, limits). Per-dimension clamp policy vocabulary ({byte,line_start,line_end}, cf. FZ b369c99) becomes the shared type. (B) zero-telemetry: prevented_* counter schema GZ writes into the TZ session ledger (graphzero-ay7m) is cross-engine wire format — types + canonical serialization shared, sinks engine-owned.

title: wave 3: zero-mcp — shared JSON-RPC 2.0 + MCP stdio server core
description: TZ jsonrpc.rs (928) + stdio.rs (484), FZ mcp_protocol/ (stdio 276 + http 377), GZ cli/mcp.rs (1258) each hand-roll JSON-RPC framing, initialize handshake, tools/list plumbing, error envelopes, stdio loop. MCP spec compliance is drift-forbidden — protocol layer belongs in one crate; engines supply a tool registry + dispatch closure. Also carries the FZ HTTP transport so any engine can opt in. Per-engine tool schemas stay engine-owned (decided).

title: conditional wave 5: 1TP atoms/gauge/ordinal grammar as zero-gauge
description: GZ plans 1TP adoption (graphzero-0odn: symbol ordinals, gauge, TA registry) and FZ may follow. TZ owns one-token-atoms fixtures, gauge arithmetic, tz://o/<gen>/<ord> ordinal grammar today. If 2+ engines speak 1TP it is a shared protocol: fixtures, atom certification checker, ordinal grammar + allocation arithmetic move to zero-gauge — also the right place to fix the omega-math finding that standalone digit atoms do not certify composed refs (certify complete grammar instances in context, per provider). Trigger: when graphzero-0odn is scheduled. Do NOT extract before then.
